title: σ and π bonds in ethene
caption: The C=C in ethene is one σ bond, from end-on overlap along the axis, and one π bond, from sideways overlap of the two p orbitals above and below the plane. The π bond is weaker and stops rotation about the double bond.
alt: Two carbon atoms joined by a σ bond along the axis, each with a vertical p orbital; the p orbitals overlap above and below to form the π bond.
description: The σ bond: a line along the C–C axis.
Each carbon also has two bonds to hydrogen, in the plane.
Above and below: the two p orbitals overlapping sideways to form the π bond.
